newsitem.title: UK: DMG makes Asquith chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: DMG makes Asquith chief operating officer.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG), the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank, said on Thursday it had promoted Jonathan Asquith to the new role of chief operating officer.

Asquith, 40, was previously chief financial officer and global head of equities, DMG said in a statement. He joined Morgan Grenfell in 1979 in Latin American project finance and has worked in OTC derivatives and treasury.
He was appointed finance director of Morgan Grenfell in 1992 and CFO of DMG in 1994. He was made global head of equities in June last year.

DMG also said that Michael Philipp, 43, would become global head of equities and would join the investment banking board. Philipp had been responsible for global market sales since joining DMG in June 1995.

Earlier this week DMG re-entered the UK equities market having withdrawn from making a market in London in 1987. The firm's eight UK equity market-makers have been quoting buy and sell prices in all 100 stocks in the blue chip FTSE 100 index and in some 60 others.
